en: Who's there? You've come to get me out? Thank you! But tell me, what's become of the Radio Tower?
Team Rocket have taken it? Then you'll need this. It's my Card Key.
It opens the shutters on the tower's third floor.
Please, I'm begging you. With the transmitter in their hands, there's no knowing what they'll do. They might even control Pokémon with some special signal!
You're the only one I can turn to. Save the Radio Tower, and every Pokémon in the land!
